data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme following an Ethical Theme.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide investors with opportunities for long term growth in capital through anactive management principle in a diversiﬁed basket of Ethical compliant equity and equity related instruments.
